chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
Excellent is the condiment vinegar, and a household will never be in need [of a condiment] if they have vinegar.

key_terms.الإِدام: Condiment or side dish, specifically referring to salty or sour foods like vinegar, pickles, or cheese that accompany bread or main meals.
key_terms.الخَلُّ: Vinegar, specifically the sour liquid used for flavoring and preservation.
key_terms.يُفتَقَرُ: To be in need or lack something essential.

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about vinegar as a food condiment?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) praises vinegar as the best condiment (*idam*), emphasizing its role in ensuring that a household never lacks a means to improve their meals. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the practical wisdom of simple, accessible foods in maintaining both physical health and domestic contentment.
